# Betaflight configuration — 5-inch 6S quadcopter
# Generated from the UHD model by @protoboardai/ext-drone (protoboard run betaflight-cli). Do not edit by hand.
# Target: MATEKF405TE · firmware >= 2025.12.1 · cloud build options: DSHOT, GPS, MAG, OSD_HD, SERIALRX_CRSF
# Syntax and values verified against @protoboardai/ext-drone skills/firmware-config/references/betaflight-reference.md.
# NOT FLIGHT-TESTED. Verify motor order, directions and compass alignment on the bench before flight.
# Every hardware UART is set below (unused ports reset to function 0), so pasting this file needs no prior reset.
# WARNING: matek-m9n-5883: QMC5883P compass (0x2C) is detected only by Betaflight >= 2025.12.1

serial UART1 2 115200 115200 0 115200      # link gnss_pads+gnss_socket~uart1~uart_gnss: stack:uart1 ↔ gnss:uart_gnss (GNSS → GPS)
serial UART2 64 115200 57600 0 115200      # link rx_fc_pads+rx_pads~crsf~uart2: stack:uart2 ↔ receiver:crsf (CRSF receiver → RX_SERIAL)
serial UART3 0 115200 57600 0 115200       # dolphinrc-f405-v3-flight-controller: UART3 has no link in the model, reset to no function
serial UART4 0 115200 57600 0 115200       # dolphinrc-f405-v3-flight-controller: UART4 has no link in the model, reset to no function
serial UART5 131073 115200 57600 0 115200  # link dji_fc+dji_o4~uart5~uart_osd: stack:uart5 ↔ video:uart_osd (DJI MSP DisplayPort → MSP + VTX_MSP)
serial UART6 0 115200 57600 0 115200       # dolphinrc-f405-v3-flight-controller: UART6 has no link in the model, reset to no function
feature TELEMETRY                          # required by the serial functions above
feature OSD                                # required by the serial functions above
feature GPS                                # required by the serial functions above
set serialrx_provider = CRSF               # receiver:crsf speaks crsf
set osd_displayport_device = MSP           # DJI O4 OSD via MSP DisplayPort (onboard analog OSD chip must not win on AUTO)
set vcd_video_system = HD                  # HD digital video system
set gps_provider = UBLOX                   # Matek M9N-5883 GNSS & Compass: u-blox receiver
set gps_auto_config = ON                   # auto-config sets the module's baud/protocol from its default
set motor_pwm_protocol = DSHOT600          # highest DShot rate both dolphinrc-f405-v3-flight-controller and dolphinrc-am32-60a-4in1-esc state (600 kbit/s)
set dshot_bidir = ON                       # both dolphinrc-f405-v3-flight-controller and dolphinrc-am32-60a-4in1-esc state bidirectional DShot (source: DolphinRC review blog only — verify)
set motor_poles = 14                       # meps-neon-2207-v2-1950kv: 12N14P stator (14 magnet poles)
set yaw_motors_reversed = OFF              # motor spins in the model (M1 CW, M2 CCW, M3 CCW, M4 CW) are Quad-X "props in", the default
set current_meter = ADC                    # dolphinrc-am32-60a-4in1-esc: analog current sensor on the FC connector
set ibata_scale = 150                      # dolphinrc-am32-60a-4in1-esc: manufacturer current scale
set ibata_offset = 0                       # dolphinrc-am32-60a-4in1-esc: manufacturer current offset
set mag_hardware = AUTO                    # link gnss_pads+gnss_socket~i2c1~i2c_compass: compass at 0x2C on stack:i2c1
set align_mag = CW270FLIP                  # matek-m9n-5883: manufacturer alignment for arrow-forward mounting — confirm in the Sensors tab
save
